title: organization-invitation-lifecycle-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.organization.invitation-send, identity.organization.invitation.accept, identity.organization.invitation.cancel, identity.organization.invitation.expire; exact inputs: tenant_id, organization_id, email, role, invitation_token; initial state: recipient is not a member and no live invitation exists

stimulus.const: Run identity.organization.invitation-send then identity.organization.invitation.accept then identity.organization.invitation.cancel then identity.organization.invitation.expire for success, failure, denial, replay, concurrency, cleanup, unknown-outcome cases using tenant_id, organization_id, email, role, invitation_token and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: send creates one invitation; accept adds one member; cancel, expiry, and replay cannot add membership; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, replay=denied/conflict, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: invitation_id, member_id, accepted_count, replay_rejected, invitation_event_digest

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: send creates one invitation; accept adds one member; cancel, expiry, and replay cannot add membership; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, replay=denied/conflict, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: invitation_id, member_id, accepted_count, replay_rejected, invitation_event_digest

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/organization-invitation-lifecycle-report.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/organization-invitation-lifecycle-report.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest
